lines.en: I walk the camp with a clipboard.
I walk fast; my soles are muddy.
I step around the fossil pit.
I jot notes as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走到围栏边上看恐龙。
lines.en: I walk to the fence to check the dinosaurs.
The hem of my white coat sweeps the dirt.
I pause, then walk on.
I walk along the hatchery wall.
I return to the lab and push the door open.

lines.zh: 我穿过一串晾着的样本。
lines.en: I pass a row of drying samples.

lines.zh: 我心里在算昨天的数据。
lines.en: I am working through yesterday's numbers.

lines.zh: 我抱着样本箱往仓库走。
lines.en: I carry a crate of samples to the store.

lines.zh: 我踩过一段新铺的石板。
lines.en: I cross a stretch of new paving.
I stand and watch the incubator.
I tap the amber sample bag.
I look down and write on the clipboard.
I push my goggles up.
I am waiting on a sequencing run.
There is an acid smell in the lab.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了一下温度计。
lines.en: I glance at the thermometer.
I am checking the tag numbers.
I wipe my face with the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 这具骨头比看上去完整。
lines.en: This skeleton is more complete than it looks.
I tuck the pen behind my ear.
Quiet moments are best for thinking.

lines.zh: 我在想基因序列的顺序。
lines.en: I am thinking through a gene sequence.
I move the lamp beside the microscope.
Is your number registered?
Do not touch that sample bag.
There is fossil dust on you.
Are you looking for a worker or for me?
I do not take on idlers here.
Is that amber in your hand?
I am looking at your boots; all mud.

lines.zh: 外边那些东西别放进来。
lines.en: Do not let those things out there in.
You could help me carry samples.
I speak quickly; forgive me.
This camp lives on data.
Are you local? You don't look it.
Put your things on the table.
I know the route you walked.
Put gloves on before you come in.
Did you hear that outside?
I'm still missing a stretch of DNA.
We had best stay inside the camp.
I step back and brace on the desk.

lines.zh: 这一下打乱了我的记录。
lines.en: That threw my notes into disorder.
My goggles are askew.
A tear opens in my sleeve.
I take a breath and steady myself.
My notes are scattered across the floor.
It hurts, but I can still walk.
You should go and call the others.
We must fall back inside.
That is a sample, not food.
Put it down first.
Amber? Let me see it.

lines.zh: 我不是为吃的东西工作。
lines.en: I do not work for food.
What is in that bag?

lines.zh: 你要是捡到化石就送来。
lines.en: If you find fossils, bring them here.

lines.zh: 我的兴趣只在这些标本上。
lines.en: My interest lies only in these specimens.
Keep that away from the incubator.
Good; I will take it.
This is worth a paper.
Sorry; I walk with my head down.
You knocked my clipboard down.
My sample bag nearly spilled.
Steady; there are cables on the floor.
We each step back; good.
Don't touch that crate.
The bump mixed up the labels.
I pick the papers up and sort them.

lines.zh: 下次绕着走，这边满地东西。
lines.en: Go around next time; the floor is cluttered.
I have no time to think of that.
The samples matter more.
Here I speak only of work.
Wrong person; I am busy.
Not now.
There are more urgent things in camp.
I steer the talk back to data.
That is not in my records.
First bring the samples back.

lines.zh: 这块琥珀里，好像有翅膀的纹路。
lines.en: There seem to be wing veins inside this amber.
I hold it to the light.
This one is well preserved.
I tag it and assign a number.
I put it in the bag.
This piece is badly fragmented.
I brush it with a small brush.
I note where it was found.
This may be a tooth.
Good; one more for the collection.
I stare toward the fence.
I lower my goggles a notch.
That stretch of fence is weak.
I need to confirm the species.
It is coming toward the hatchery.
This should not be happening.
I shut the door and drop the bar.
Is anyone else out there?
Do not go out yet; wait.

lines.zh: 我在算它到门口还有几步。
lines.en: I am counting its steps to the door.
It is testing the fence.
I pick up a marker gun.
I am not combat personnel.
You are the better one to go out.
We have to hold it back.
It walks along the fence.
It is smelling this place.

lines.zh: 我看它的步态，是猎食者。
lines.en: The gait says predator.
I retreat behind the specimen shelves.
It hit the boards once.
I am looking for the tranquilizer.
Its breathing is loud.

lines.zh: 我把桌上的东西扫进抽屉。
lines.en: I sweep the desk into a drawer.
It has stopped at the door.
I hear the boards splitting.
I fall back to where you said.
I have forceps, not a blade.
If it comes in, we retreat first.
Don't shout; it will draw more.
Now, move.
I raise the marker gun.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，只擦到皮。
lines.en: That shot went wide, only grazing.
I block with the specimen clamp.
It charges and I fall across the desk.
I throw a handful of dirt.
It backs half a step, still watching.
I brace the door board.
There was no force in that.
You go in; I fall back behind you.
I am panting and my hands shake.
That buys us a few steps.
I tip the sample crate to block the way.
It catches my sleeve.
I pull free and the sleeve tears.

lines.zh: 拿好试管，这针是给恐龙的。
lines.en: Hold the vial steady; this dose is for the dinosaur.
We do not have much time.

lines.zh: 我在营地的实验室里站定。
lines.en: I take my place in the camp lab.
Last night's notes lie open on the desk.
This batch of samples still waits.
Dinosaurs are calling outside.
I tug my coat cuff straight.
I settle my goggles on.
A new day, new data.
The incubator is at the right temperature.
Someone has come in at the door.

lines.zh: 我把琥珀样本放进保险柜。
lines.en: I lock the amber samples in the safe.
Someone is walking outside the fence.
I check today's sampling sheet.
Everything in camp is as usual.
I open the window for some air.
I button my coat properly.
The samples on the desk are still warm.
I count the crates; one is missing.
First I clean my hands.
Fire catches my white coat.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下来，膝盖磕了。
lines.en: I fall from the steps and bang my knee.
Water floods my goggles.
The blast overturns the equipment.
An arrow grazes my shoulder and breaks the skin.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我头发竖起。
lines.en: That force stands my hair on end.
A whole day without food and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷打在营地边上，灯全灭了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the camp edge and all lights die.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，抓到的都是空的。
lines.en: I fall, grasping at nothing.
